Neither is ground truth.

caveats: Four source days only. The folds are not four independent statistical experiments: each training set shares two days with every other training set.
Every day carries a different attack family, so every fold is simultaneously an unseen-family test. Cross-day variation and cross-family variation cannot be separated.
Persistence receives the observed label A(t); V4 and LR receive only features.
Fold 4 (Mar-02) is a NEW experiment, not a replacement for the frozen V4 reference.
Windows inside one episode are temporally dependent; episode counts per day are 2-5.
